experiment: E45 raw-waveform CNN with adversarial training (RA-oriented)
motivation: All fixed-feature routes (logSPD WCCN, residual MLP+ARPL, band-correlation, supervised detectors) fail at SNR20: RA 0.02-0.09. A single-fold probe showed a raw-waveform CNN trained with PGD7 adversarial training reaches PGD20/SNR20 direct accuracy 0.551 and RA 0.473, a 6x improvement. E45 turns that probe into a full nested evaluation with rejection, unknown handling and the official score.

data.source: Train session1 only; read-only reuse of E36 raw cache

model.input: raw 18x1200, per-trial per-channel mean removal and global std normalization inside forward
model.architecture: Conv1d(18->96,k9,s2)-BN-ELU, Conv1d(96->192,k9,s2)-BN-ELU, Conv1d(192->384,k9,s2)-BN-ELU, Conv1d(384->384,k9,s2)-BN-ELU, global average pool, linear 384->K
model.output: K logits; confidence uses softmax distance_ratio

training.adversarial: raw-waveform PGD 7 steps, radius = centered-signal L2 / 10^(SNR/20)
training.snr_mix: equal probability SNR20 / SNR30 per batch
training.seed_rule: seed_base + 1000*outer_fold + inner_fold; batch seeds from epoch/batch index

evaluation.inner_folds: E36 five outer groups x two inner folds, identical subject splits and continuous trial blocks
evaluation.subset: E36 stratified first 8 trials per identity/task for clean known and pseudo-unknown
evaluation.aggregation: per inner run in its own label space, average two inner runs, then average five outer folds
evaluation.decision: accept iff softmax distance_ratio >= threshold; threshold = q05 of that run's inner clean-known distance_ratio

targets.note: E45 is the first route where RA is not the binding constraint; judge against the same gates as E36C

stop_rule: if the inner macro RA is below 0.5, record the negative result and stop; do not run outer or Test

reporting.evidence_boundary: Train-only inner nesting, pseudo-unknown subjects, continuous file-block proxy; attacks are generated white-box against the evaluated model, which E44 showed is not weaker than transfer. No outer, no Test, no cross-session claim.
